description: Two views of the same small chibi pixel art character, bald, with long pointed ears: on the left seen from the front, on the right seen from behind. Paint only inside the white of the mask: give the bald head a short tousled pixie cut: close and short at the nape and over the ears, fuller and longer on top in messy layered locks, with one curl falling onto the forehead among the bangs. The bangs are natural everyday bangs, like ordinary hair: a few soft locks of different lengths with tapered pointed tips coming down to just above the eyes, a little forehead showing between them, never a straight horizontal edge and never a broad bare band of forehead. The hair covers the whole top of the head. It falls in clear thick locks with darker lines between them, and every end tapers into points of slightly different lengths, never one straight cut. The same hairstyle in both views, in big bold locks. The hair is one bright grass green, shaded only with darker greens and outlined with the same thick dark outline, with no other colours inside the hair. The long pointed ears still poke out through the hair. Do not change the face, the eyes, the body or the clothes. Keep the same chunky pixel size and the same flat shading, nothing else added, transparent background.
